reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000849 (the melody read from 000849a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Lowell Mason's dates (1792–1872) are from our page for the tune BETHANY (content/hymns/tunes/bethany.json); CCEH's page gives only the year 1839. The page gives no year for the tune itself; it was in print by 1839, the year of the arrangement. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000849a.nwc).
